varsKey: Type a variable in square brackets anywhere in a heading or a text box below and the page fills in its value from SHARED VALUES. Change it in one place, every page changes. The ones that always exist: [businessName] [ownerName] [siteDomain] [contactEmail] [privacyEmail] [mailingStreet] [mailingCity] [mailingState] [mailingZip] [state] [county] [region]. TWO PAIRS ARE DELIBERATELY SEPARATE. The mailing address carries its own city, state and ZIP: those are where post is sent, while [state] and [county] are the law the site runs under and where a dispute would be heard, so moving the address never rewrites the Governing law section. And [privacyEmail] is used by the privacy policy while [contactEmail] is used by the terms page and anything general. Anything you add under YOUR OWN VARIABLES works the same way: name one bookingEmail and type [bookingEmail]. A variable you have not filled in yet shows on the page as an amber [... to be added] note instead of vanishing, so a blank can never read as a finished sentence. A word in brackets that is not one of your variables is left exactly as typed.

sections.heading: Rental requests are requests, not reservations

blocks.text: Submitting the rental form does not book equipment. The dates, items, and prices shown in the online rental flow are an estimate and a request only. No rental is reserved, priced, or confirmed until we and you agree in writing through a signed rental agreement and/or invoice. Availability is not guaranteed until confirmed. The binding rental terms, including rates, deposits, insurance and certificate-of-insurance requirements, pickup and return, and any late, cleaning, loss, or damage fees, are set out in that separate rental agreement, which controls over anything shown on this site.
You are responsible for providing accurate information in any request. Estimated totals shown on the site are recalculated and confirmed by us before any agreement is finalized.

When you submit a contact, rental, or crew inquiry form, you authorize us to contact you about your inquiry using the information you provide. Do not submit confidential information you do not want us to receive. Our handling of the information you submit is described in our Privacy Policy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information [businessName] collects when you use [siteDomain] (the Studio, Rentals, and Media pages), how we use it, and the choices you have.

blocks.text: [businessName] is an independent film studio operated as a sole proprietorship by [ownerName], based in the [region] area. In this policy, "we," "us," and "our" mean [businessName]. This policy covers the website at [siteDomain] and its sub-sections at <nobr>/rentals</nobr> and <nobr>/media</nobr>.
Information you give us
When you use our contact form, rental-request form, or crew-inquiry form, you may provide:

items: Your name, email address, and phone number;
Your company or production name, and details about your project;
For a rental request: the equipment you select and the pickup and return dates you request.

blocks.text: Information collected automatically

items: Your IP address, browser and device type, and the pages you view;
Cookie and similar identifiers set by the services described in Section 4.
To respond to your inquiry and prepare a rental quote or project proposal;
To schedule equipment pickups and returns;
To keep a record of our conversation and any booking in our customer-management tools;
To operate, secure, and improve the website.

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not send marketing or newsletter emails. When you contact us, a real person replies to you directly about your request.

Our contact and inquiry forms are provided by HubSpot and Jotform, which set cookies when their forms load. HubSpot's cookies (for example __hstc, hubspotutk, __hssc, and __hssrc) help those forms function and let HubSpot recognize a returning visitor; HubSpot may collect information about your activity over time and across other websites that use HubSpot. Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, may set cookies necessary for security and performance.

We do not load HubSpot while you are simply browsing. Its form, and the cookies above, load only when you open a contact or inquiry form, or when you accept cookies using the banner shown on your first visit. You can also control or delete cookies through your browser settings, though blocking them may affect how the embedded forms work.

sections.heading: Third parties who process your information

blocks.text: We share information only with the service providers that help us run the site and respond to you. We do not sell or rent your information to anyone.

rows.label: HubSpot
rows.text: Contact form, customer-relationship management, and form analytics. May set tracking cookies and collect activity across sites over time.

rows.label: Jotform
rows.text: Hosts our rental-request and crew-inquiry forms and delivers your submission to us.

rows.label: Google Calendar
rows.text: Stores rental pickup and return events created from your request so we can schedule your booking.

rows.label: Cloudflare
rows.text: Website hosting, content delivery, and security.

rows.label: Supabase
rows.text: Database that stores rental booking records.

blocks.text: Each of these providers processes your information under its own privacy policy.

We do not currently respond to browser "Do Not Track" (DNT) signals, because there is no common industry standard for how to interpret them. Third-party services embedded on our site (such as HubSpot) may collect information as described above regardless of a DNT setting.

sections.heading: Reviewing, changing, or deleting your information

blocks.text: You may ask us to review, correct, or delete the information you submitted, or the record we hold about your inquiry. Email [privacyEmail] and we will respond within a reasonable time.

We keep your information for as long as needed to respond to your inquiry, fulfill a booking, and meet ordinary business and record-keeping needs, then delete or archive it. We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect the information we hold, though no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.
This site is not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.

Because of our size, [businessName] is not a "business" required to comply with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA). We do not sell or share personal information as those terms are defined by the CCPA. [state] residents may still contact us with any privacy question or request, and we will do our best to honor it.
If we make a material change, we will post the updated policy at this URL with a new effective date. Please check back from time to time.
